system.description:
When you cast this jutsu you must spend one ammunition die that is at least a d4 in size or greater.

You prep as many shots as you desire and Fire them in an arc that then begin to rain down overwhelming all within range.

Select a point you can see within range. All creatures within a 10 feet radius of the select point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapons damage] + 2d8. Creatures who fail their saving throw by 5 or more are pinned to the ground, being knocked Prone and Restrained. A creature Restrained in this way can spend their action to make a Strength (Athletic) check vs your Taijutsu save DC to escape, ending the Restrained condition.

Chain 2: You instead reduce your ammunition die size by 1 step, instead of spending the whole die.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
